# meraki_organization_policies_global_group_policies (Data Source)

This data source can read the `Organization Policies Global Group Policy` configuration in bulk.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "meraki_organization_policies_global_group_policies" "example" {
  organization_id = "123456"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes Set) The list of items (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description of the policy
- `group_number` (Number) Group number used to track the policy across different networks and devices in the organization
- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `name` (String) Name of the policy
